content_sections.heading: Chandigarh Animal Husbandry Veterinary Inspector at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify an application fee or the selection process, and it prints no calendar date for the last date.

rows.details: Department of Animal Husbandry & Fisheries, Chandigarh Administration
Pay Level 5 (Rs.29200-92300) as per 7th Central Pay Commission
Matric or 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry & Biology, and a two-year diploma in Veterinary Science
Post or hand delivery to the Joint Director's office; the notice says applications "should reach" the office, and the mode of dispatch is not specified
Must reach within 60 days from the date of publication in the 'Employment News'

content_sections.heading: About the Chandigarh Animal Husbandry Department
content_sections.text: The Department of Animal Husbandry & Fisheries works under the Chandigarh Administration. The notice is issued from the office of the Joint Director, Govt. Veterinary Hospital (Behind Kiran Cinema), Sector-22 C, Chandigarh-160022, and signed by the Director Animal Husbandry. The department's website is given as http://www.chdanimalhusbandry.gov.in/ and its phone number as 0172-2700092.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible officials should apply for the post and also forward their applications through their department. Completed applications should reach the following address: O/o Joint Director, Animal Husbandry & Fisheries, Govt. Vety. Hospital, Sector-22 C, Chandigarh-160022 Time limit: within 60 days from the date of publication in the 'Employment News'. Form: the application/bio-data must be on the prescribed proforma, in original, as per DoPT O.M No.A.B14017/28/2014/Estt.(RR) dated 02.07.2015. The notice gives the link http://documents.doptcirculars.nic.in/D2/D02est/14017_28_2014-Estt.RR02072015.pdf . The notice and the curriculum Vitae Proforma (Annexure-A) can be downloaded from https://chandigarh.gov.in/information/public-notices . The notice does not print an email address for sending applications, an envelope superscription or a postal mode.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from willing and eligible officials from the States of Punjab and Haryana, purely on deputation basis. Officials/Officers of Central Govt./State Government/Union Territories holding analogous posts on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department. OR officials possessing the qualification and experience prescribed for direct recruitment. Matric or 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry & Biology. Diploma in Veterinary Science of two years duration from any University/Institution recognised by Central/State Government. The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of application. No relaxation is printed in the notice. Pay Level 5 (Rs.29200-92300) as per 7th Central Pay Commission. Pay+DA, Daily Allowances, T.A., Joining time and Transfer T.A., Leave Travel Concession, Medical concession and accommodation: as per Govt. of India, DoPT O.M. No. DOPT-1726140763694 dated 28.03.2024, adopted by Chandigarh Administration, Department of Personnel vide No.28/16/94-IH(7)-2025/4045 dated 25.3.2025, No.28/16/94-IH(7)-2025/6954 dated 27.5.2025 and No.50167-28/16/94-IH(7)2026/1275 dated 5.2.2026. No deputation (duty) allowance shall be payable. Period of deputation: three years in the first instance, to be extended from time to time or reduced according to requirements. The period of deputation, including deputation in another ex cadre post immediately preceding this appointment, shall be as per the instructions/guidelines issued by the Government from time to time. Leave and pension: the rules of the parent Department. Leave salary and pension contribution: the allocation payable by this Administration will be regulated under the rules of the parent Government. The terms and conditions are subject to revision as per Central Civil Service Rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: While forwarding an application, the concerned department should furnish these documents and certificates: Application/Bio-data on the prescribed proforma (in original). Up-to-date APAR/ACR in annotated form of the applicant(s) for the last five years. Integrity Certificate signed by the Head of the Institution. Vigilance Clearance Certificate indicating that no disciplinary proceedings or criminal proceedings are either pending or contemplated against the Officer concerned. Certificate regarding no court case pending against the officer concerned, signed by the Head of the Institution. Statement of major/minor penalties, if any, imposed on the candidate during the last 10 years, or a no penalty Certificate, as the case may be.

rows.details: Proforma to be sent with the application
Public notice of the Department of Animal Husbandry & Fisheries

faq.question: Q1. How many Veterinary Inspector posts are there in Chandigarh Animal Husbandry?
faq.answer: There are 05 (Five) posts of Veterinary Inspector (Group 'C') in the Department of Animal Husbandry & Fisheries, Chandigarh Administration.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the O/o Joint Director within 60 days from the date of publication of the notice in the 'Employment News'. The notice prints no calendar date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Veterinary Inspector?
faq.answer: Matric or 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry & Biology, and a diploma in Veterinary Science of two years duration from a University/Institution recognised by Central/State Government.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the Veterinary Inspector post?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Level 5 (Rs.29200-92300) as per 7th Central Pay Commission, with Pay+DA as per the DoPT O.M. dated 28.03.2024 as adopted by Chandigarh Administration.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Eligible officials apply and forward the application through their department, with the listed documents, so that it reaches the O/o Joint Director, Animal Husbandry & Fisheries, Govt. Vety. Hospital, Sector-22 C, Chandigarh-160022.

faq.question: Q7. Who can apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Willing and eligible officials from the States of Punjab and Haryana can apply. They should be Central Govt./State Government/Union Territory officials holding analogous posts on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department, or possess the qualification and experience prescribed for direct recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the posts are purely on deputation. The period is three years in the first instance, to be extended from time to time or reduced according to requirements.

faq.question: Q9. Is a deputation allowance paid?
faq.answer: No deputation (duty) allowance shall be payable, according to the notice.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must the department send with an application?
faq.answer: The department must furnish the bio-data proforma in original, APAR/ACR for the last five years, an Integrity Certificate, a Vigilance Clearance Certificate, a no court case certificate and a statement of penalties of the last 10 years (or a no penalty certificate).
